definition.value: Annual firm asset growth rate (ASSETG), calculated as the year-on-year percentage change in total assets.

evidence.quote: Our main variable of concern, the annual firm asset growth rate (ASSETG), is calculated using the year-on-year percentage change in total assets (Compustat data item 6).

economic_intuition.value: Asset growth captures comprehensive firm investment and disinvestment; higher growth predicts lower subsequent returns, consistent with investor overextrapolation of past gains to growth.

evidence.quote: Overall, our findings are most consistent with the interpretation that investors overextrapolate past gains to growth.
we document a strong negative correlation between a firm’s asset growth and subsequent abnormal returns.
